---
name: New or improved dimension
about: Measure a dimension COVERAGE.md lists as not measured, or change how one is measured
labels: dimension
---

**Dimension(s)** (id and name from `rubrics/<version>/rubric-catalog.json`)

**What the published catalog says it measures** (`whatItMeasures`, `evaluator`, `family`)

**Current state** (the COVERAGE.md row / not-measured reason)

**Proposed approach** (deterministic and offline by default; anything model-backed or runtime must be opt-in and advisory)

**How it will be tested** (fixture that must fire, near-miss that must not, benchmark units affected)

**Spec ambiguities met** (to be recorded in SPEC-GAPS.md)
